description: This Java source file defines the QueryParser class, which creates Query objects from various search commands related to 'thingsearch' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles parsing criteria, options, and different command types such as QueryThings, StreamThings, and SudoCountThings.

classes.name: QueryParser
classes.description: A utility class for creating Query objects from search commands, supporting criteria parsing and option setting.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new QueryParser instance with specified criteria, field expression, and query builder factories.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Converts a ThingSearchQueryCommand into a Query object, handling options and different command types.

methods.name: parseSudoCountThings
methods.description: Converts a SudoCountThings command into a Query object.

methods.name: parseCriteria
methods.description: Parses criteria from a search command, considering namespaces and filters.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Parses and applies options to a QueryBuilder, handling exceptions.
